name: Halden Trail Mid Hiker
description:
A mid-height hiking boot with a mesh and synthetic leather upper, padded ankle collar, and Halden's multi-lug rubber outsole. Lightweight for its protection level, with a shank stiff enough for uneven terrain but not so rigid it's uncomfortable on pavement. Available in earthy tones — bark, granite, and a faded sage.

Equally at home on a weekend trail outside the megacity or walking the cracked sidewalks of outer Tier 2 districts where terrain is genuinely unpredictable. A crossover boot that doesn't advertise itself.
functionality: torsional stability shank, weather-resistant upper treatment
what_it_says: You spend time outside real structures, or at least you're ready to.
story_hooks: A pair of Haldens found at a crime scene is caked in soil that doesn't match anywhere near the location — someone traveled far before they ended up here.
Halden's outer-district distribution means their boots occasionally get used as informal dead drops by people who know the supply chain well.
